- **Hero Section**: Dark background with "JETOUR X70 Plus" headline, car image, and red buttons (dark background).

- **Technology Section**: Dark background with "Двигатель technologies" headline (dark background).  
- **Brand History**: Dark background with "JETOUR-ийн аялал" (JETOUR's journey) text (dark background).  
- **Service Section**: Dark background with "Тантай хөлбөртөй" (Service) headline (dark background).  
- **Footer**: Dark background with brand info, contact details, and links (dark background).  
- **Visible Issue**: Empty dark sections (e.g., between brand nav and model overview) with no content.  
- **Visible Issue**: Inconsistent background contrast (some dark sections lack visual hierarchy).  
- **Visible Issue**: Overlapping text/elements in the hero section (e.g., "JETOUR X70 Plus" and buttons).
